title: Production reliability hardening
focus: Turn the Build 210 connected live workflow into a production-readiness pass: provider configuration, hosted final-balance checkout, upload/retention diagnostics, end-to-end environment checks, and fewer owner actions.
completed_20: Added a production reliability registry for notifications, hosted payment links, mobile uploads, retention, Cloudflare/Supabase/R2 checks, and owner simplification.
Added /admin-production.html as a single production-readiness screen.
Added /api/admin/production_reliability_report for environment/table/workflow diagnostics without exposing secrets.
Added notification provider readiness checks for email/SMS webhook configuration and queued/failed events.
Added /api/admin/notification_provider_test for controlled provider test sends or configuration-only checks.
Added hosted final-balance checkout creation through /api/admin/final_balance_checkout_create.
Added Stripe Checkout Session support for final balance requests when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is configured.
Kept manual-payment fallback when hosted payment providers are not configured.
Added final-balance payment-link readiness warnings to the production report.
Added upload reliability reporting for failed/cancelled/uploading live upload sessions.
Added storage retention reporting for due/expired job media that is not permanent proof or legal hold.
Added /api/admin/storage_retention_sweep with dry-run default and review-before-archive behavior.
Added migration support for provider test logs, retention audit rows, final balance checkout metadata, and production reliability audit snapshots.
Added Admin Dashboard production reliability diagnostics card.
Added Admin Dashboard shortcut card to the production readiness screen.
Added production reliability tasks into Today Needs Attention when provider, payment, upload, or retention issues need owner action.
Added visual placeholder category for production reliability / end-to-end testing.
Updated the two canonical Markdown files with current production-risk status and the next 20 reliability steps.
Updated historical root Markdown, schema docs, service worker cache, route-copy sync, and release guards.
Added Build 211 release guard covering new screens, APIs, migration, docs, routes, and registry markers.

Add notification delivery templates for each live-workflow event type.
Add customer/staff notification preference controls and quiet-hour rules.
Add true multipart/resumable upload for large videos using R2 or Supabase TUS where practical.

Add a scheduled storage-retention worker that produces a review queue before deleting any customer/job media.
Add a storage orphan detector for objects with no linked job_media/live_upload_sessions row.
Add payment-link expiry and resend controls.

Add alert thresholds for failed notifications, upload failures, open payment requests, and overdue retention review.
